rows: A storm chaser group reported a tornado northwest of Throckmorton from the same supercell that produced a tornado in northern Shakelford County. The tornado was visible for just a short time before becoming rain wrapped. The tornado remained over open range land.
A brief tornado developed over open country. No damage.
Large trees were blown down around the Woodson Community. Little structural damage was noted.
